draft.title: Rates of reaction
card: The rate of a reaction is how fast reactants are used up or products are made. Collision theory says a reaction needs particles to collide, and only some collisions are successful.
A higher temperature makes particles move faster. They collide more often and more of the collisions are successful, so the rate rises.

A higher concentration puts more particles in the same volume, so collisions happen more often. A larger surface area of a solid exposes more particles to collide, so crushing a solid into powder speeds up the reaction.
A catalyst also speeds up a reaction. It is not used up. How it works is taught in the next point.
draft.remember: Anything that makes successful collisions more frequent speeds up a reaction.

a.q: Why does a more concentrated acid react faster with magnesium ribbon?
opts: More acid particles per volume mean more frequent collisions
Each acid particle moves much faster than before
The magnesium ribbon has a larger surface area
The acid is no longer used up in the reaction
a.why: A higher concentration means more particles in each unit of volume, so collisions with the metal happen more often. Speed of particles is linked to temperature, not concentration, so the second option is wrong.
a.clue: Think about how many particles fit in the same volume.

b.q: Sam adds the same mass of calcium carbonate to the same acid at the same temperature. One test uses a single lump and one uses fine powder. Why is the powder faster?
opts: More surface is exposed, so more collisions with acid happen
The powder particles move faster than the lump particles
The powder lowers the temperature of the acid
The powder acts as a catalyst and is not used up
b.why: Powder exposes far more of the solid to the acid, so collisions are more frequent. The temperature is the same in both tests, so particle speed is not the cause. The powder is a reactant and is used up, so it is not a catalyst.
b.clue: Only the amount of exposed solid has changed.

a.best: More acid particles per volume mean more frequent collisions

b.best: More surface is exposed, so more collisions with acid happen
